IdentityRegistry.notes: ERC-8004 subset (ERC-721+URIStorage), same mechanism as DAO-WARDEN's reference impl but a fresh, separate deploy for PactAI. Adds agentIdOf(wallet) reverse lookup, not present in DAO-WARDEN's version.

JobReputationRegistry.notes: PactAI's reputation signal, deliberately different from DAO-WARDEN's ValidationRegistry: no independent validator, recordOutcome(jobId) is permissionless and reads JobEscrow's own terminal state (Released/Refunded) directly.

requester.note: Circle Agent Wallet -- registered via `circle wallet execute`, not a locally-signed tx.

reputationRecords.notes: recordOutcome called on the 3 jobs funded during earlier smoke testing (2 Released, 1 Refunded on timeout). getSummary(1) == 3 total, 2 released, 66% release rate.

notes: USDC address is the 6-decimal ERC-20 view of Arc's native gas USDC. Verified post-deploy with cast: code present, usdc() == 0x3600...0000. Source code verified on arcscan (Blockscout) 2026-07-21 — readable source + ABI at the explorer link.
